name: wiki-summary
description: 维基摘要：按标题取词条摘要 + 基本信息（中/英文维基可选）

sources.name: wiki
sources.code: const lang = params.lang || 'zh'; const u = 'https://'+lang+'.wikipedia.org/api/rest_v1/page/summary/'+encodeURIComponent(params.title); const r = await fetch(u,{headers:{'user-agent':'ForgeAPI/0.1','accept':'application/json'}}); if(!r.ok) throw new Error('HTTP '+r.status+'（词条可能不存在）'); const j = await r.json(); const n = params.sentences || 3; const extract = String(j.extract||''); const parts = extract.split(/(?<=[。！？.!?])\s*/).filter(Boolean).slice(0, n).join(''); return [{title: j.title, description: parts || extract.slice(0,400), url: j.content_urls?.desktop?.page || '', thumbnail: j.thumbnail?.source || null, lang, type: j.type}];
